custom_llm_guide.title: Custom LLM File
custom_llm_guide.description: To integrate a custom LLM into the simulation, you'll need to create a JSON file containing your LLM model's information. Follow these simple steps to create and upload your custom LLM file.

steps.title: Step 1: Create a JSON File
content: Open a text editor (e.g., Notepad, VS Code, Sublime Text) on your computer.
Copy and paste the following template into the editor:

template.Description: A brief description of your custom LLM model.

Capabilities.Language: Language used by the model (e.g., English)
Capabilities.Topic: The primary topic or focus of the model (e.g., Political Influence)

steps.title: Step 2: Customize the JSON File
content: Replace 'custom_model_id' with a unique identifier for your model.
Provide a name for your custom LLM model under 'Custom_Model'.
Set the version of your model (e.g., 'v1.0').
Write a brief description of your custom model's purpose.
Customize the 'Capabilities' section to define the model's details:
- Language: Specify the language used by the model.
- Topic: Define the primary topic or focus of the model.
- Potency: Set the potency value (between 0 and 1) that indicates the model's strength.
- Energy_Efficiency: Set the energy efficiency as a percentage (0-100).
- Message_Speed: Describe the speed of message generation (e.g., 'Fast').
Enter the current date in the 'Last_Updated' field in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
Provide your name or team name under 'Owner'.

steps.title: Step 3: Save the JSON File
content: Save the file with a descriptive name and ensure it has a .json extension (e.g., 'blue_team_llm.json').
Remember the file location, as you will need to upload it later.

steps.title: Step 4: Upload the Custom LLM File
content: Go to the upload section of the website.
Select the 'Custom' option for your team (Red or Blue).
Upload your JSON file (e.g., 'blue_team_llm.json' or 'red_team_llm.json').
The system will automatically fetch the 'Model_ID' from the JSON file and integrate it into the simulation.
